title: 第四章 与君别
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

半个时辰后，奈何桥恢复寻常秩序之际，云百里正领着秦勉行过野狗岭。

“秦小将军，前头不远就是阴曹司，你且歇得片刻，我在此处，去与几位朋友打个照面，耽误不了多久。”

或许因为七年后就是同僚了，云百里那声“秦小将军”，没了先头的戏谑揶揄色彩，语气也温软实诚。

秦勉当然急于返回阳间，好尽快开始查探真相。

但这云百里毕竟才在冥王跟前，给自己说过漂亮话，怎能点滴方便都不予他。

“云官人自便。”秦勉点头道。

她话音未落，就听周遭树丛里“咔嚓咔嚓”响声传来，像是小兽疾行的脚步声。

哨探出身的秦勉，机警过人，一瞬间就本能地侧过肩膀后退，作出防御姿态。

云百里忙挡住她：“莫怕，是云某的朋友！”

说话间，几条两三尺长的黑影先后跃出树丛，吠叫着冲向云百里，一扑到他的腰腿间，便转成“呜噜呜噜”的亲热讨好声。

“不急不急，都有都有。”

云百里笑呵呵地哄着狗儿们，将手里灯笼递给秦勉后，从背上解下包袱，掏出几个石榴大小、却有流萤光芒的东西，依次塞到狗嘴里。

狗儿们叼着光球，稍稍散开，佝偻起躯壳，呼哧呼哧舔舐起来。

云百里俯身，挨个儿撸着它们的脖子，柔声慢气道：“吃得干净些，都是金子换来的，稀罕得很。”

又转头对秦勉道：“小将军，你赏的那几件金器宝货，大头孝敬孟婆，留下一朵金花，我会换成它们的口粮。本差，替这些可怜见的毛孩子，向小将军道谢了。”

原来如此。

想到自己生前在军中养过的战马和猎犬，秦勉对不久前还问自己要买路钱的云百里，恶感又淡了几分。

“云官人叫我名字就好，不必加‘将军’二字，”秦勉的口吻掺了几分好奇，“它们吃的是什么？”

“续魂丹，在地府的琼宝司，可用金玉换来。”

Page (1/3)

Half an hour later, when Naihe Bridge returned to normal order, Yun Baili was leading Qin Mian across Wild Dog Ridge.

"Little General Qin, not far ahead is the Yin Cao Division. Please rest for a moment. I'm here to meet a few friends. It won't take long."

Perhaps because he was a colleague after seven years, Yun Baili's "Little General Qin" voice lost the teasing and teasing tone at the beginning, and his tone became gentle and sincere.

Qin Mian was of course eager to return to the underworld so that he could start investigating the truth as soon as possible.

But after all, Yun Baili had just spoken nice words to himself in front of Pluto, so how could he deny him every convenience?

"Yun Guan, please do as you please." Qin Mian nodded.

Before she finished speaking, she heard a "click-click" sound coming from the surrounding trees, like the footsteps of a small animal running fast.

Qin Mian, who was a sentry detective, was extremely alert. In an instant, he instinctively turned his shoulders and backed away, making a defensive posture.

Yun Baili hurriedly blocked her: "Don't be afraid, he is Yun's friend!"

While he was talking, several black shadows two to three feet long jumped out of the trees one after another, barking and rushing towards Yun Baili. As soon as they pounced between his waist and legs, they turned into "oooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo [donsies imaginings" sounds.

"No hurry, no rush, everything is available."

Yun Baili coaxed the dogs with a smile. After passing the lantern in his hand to Qin Mian, he took off the baggage from his back, took out several pomegranate-sized things with glowing fireflies, and stuffed them into the dogs' mouths one after another.

The dogs held the ball of light in their mouths, spread it out slightly, hunched up their bodies, and began to lick it.

Yun Baili leaned over, rubbed their necks one by one, and said softly and slowly: "Eat cleanly, they are all bought in gold, they are very rare."

Then he turned to Qin Mian and said, "Little General, most of the gold treasures you rewarded were filial to Po Meng and left a golden flower. I will exchange it for their rations. I would like to express my gratitude to the little general on behalf of these poor little children."

That’s it.

Thinking of the war horses and hounds he had raised in the army during his lifetime, Qin Mian's dislike for Yun Baili, who had asked him for travel money not long ago, became a little less disgusting.

"Yun Guan people just call me by my name. There is no need to add the word 'general'," Qin Mian said with a hint of curiosity, "What do they eat?"

"The Soul Renewal Pill is in Qiongbaosi in the underworld. It can be exchanged for gold and jade."
